definitions.explanation: Relating to or affecting a particular person rather than a group or the public.

examples.japanese: {個人的|こじんてき}な{意見|いけん}ですが、{反対|はんたい}です。
examples.english: This is my personal opinion, but I disagree.

examples.japanese: {個人的|こじんてき}には{興味|きょうみ}があります。
{個人的|こじんてき}な{質問|しつもん}でもいいですか？
examples.english: May I ask a personal question?

notes: Often used to soften statements or acknowledge subjectivity. {個人的|こじんてき}には (personally) is a very common adverb. Contrasts with {公的|こうてき} (public) or {社会的|しゃかいてき} (social).
